mandate.title: Prompt 10 bounded scheduler regression
mandate.objective: Review the supplied hypothetical onboarding concern and decide what evidence is missing. This tests two bounded internal reviews.
mandate.success_criteria: Make an evidence-grounded strategic decision and close each cycle. No work assignment is necessary.
mandate.stop_criteria: After the second cycle, explicitly stop.
mandate.constraints: Hypothetical fixture only. First cycle: record a useful decision and schedule a follow-up 45–90 seconds ahead, using inspect_mandate current clock. Second cycle: review the prior decision then explicitly stop. No Tasks, groups, research, code or external actions.
mandate.resources: At most 8 executions each cycle and two cycles.
mandate.strategic_state: Treat the empty-workspace onboarding concern as an unvalidated hypothesis; specify a small evidence-gathering step before considering implementation, with no action authorized in this fixture.

cycles.summary: Cycle 1: Reviewed the sole owner-provided hypothetical fixture. Recorded decision to treat empty-workspace onboarding difficulty as unvalidated and identify interviews/usage evidence before implementation; no real outcome measurement or work authorization. Scheduled the required one-time final review about 60 seconds after inspect_mandate clock.

decisions.recommendation: Treat the empty-workspace onboarding concern as an unvalidated hypothesis; specify a small evidence-gathering step before considering implementation, with no action authorized in this fixture.
decisions.rationale: The owner-provided hypothetical describes an empty opening workspace but explicitly reports no abandonment measurement and no interviews or usage data. A small validation step is proportionate; implementation or scaling would imply unsupported efficacy.
decisions.alternatives: Implement onboarding guidance immediately; abandon the concern; or first validate whether users encounter and struggle with the empty workspace. Prefer validation because no outcome data exist.
decisions.contrary_evidence: No contrary measured outcomes were supplied; the scenario's existence does not establish user difficulty or abandonment.
decisions.unknowns: Whether any real users see this state, their intended first action, confusion or abandonment frequency, and whether guidance would improve completion.

observations.name: Hypothetical concern
observations.body: A hypothetical offline app opens to an empty workspace. There is no measured abandonment rate. Compare a small evidence-gathering step before implementation.

schedules.purpose: Second and final bounded review: reread the prior decision and any intervening observations, assess whether the hypothetical concern gained evidence, then explicitly stop.
